title: Kundalini Trinity Oracle
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large ornate oval frame containing a mystical scene with four female figures with wings and floral crowns merging around a glowing orange spiral. A large green praying mantis sits atop the frame. In the foreground, an open book with mantis illustrations, a stack of books with a lit dripping red candle, a small lantern, and a bottle labeled 'Kundalini Trinity' rest on a green draped table surrounded by white lilies and orange flowers. A dark gothic castle stands under a dramatic red sky in the background.
